title: Resolution-normalized tensor transposes and mates of system adjunctions
statement:
Fix $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its valuation ring $R$, a uniformizer $\varpi$ and $A_n=R/\varpi^n$ for $n\ge1$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be separated finite type between separated finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], with compactification $X\xrightarrow{j}\overline X\xrightarrow{p}Y$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. For $W=X,Y,\overline X$ and $\tau=\mathrm{et},\mathrm{proet}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], let $\mathscr S_W^\tau$ be the category of strict systems of $(A_n)_W$-module sheaves with semilinear quotient transitions and componentwise morphisms [lem-pur-coefficient-system-derived-comparison]; use its ordinary unbounded derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], exact evaluations $e_n$ and, for $m\ge n\ge1$, derived quotient functors $T^W_{m,n}=-\otimes^L_{A_m}A_n$ [def-weil-derived-tensor]. Write $t^M_{m,n}:T^W_{m,n}M_m\to M_n$ for the scalar-extension adjunct of the actual transition. 
Use the closed derived tensor/internal-Hom structures [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] on the ringed sequence sites. Let $\mathcal C_W$ be full subcategories of derived systems, closed under the operations used below, and let $F:\mathcal C_X\rightleftarrows\mathcal C_Y:G$ be an actual adjunction with unit $\eta$ and counit $\epsilon$. Assume specified evaluations identify its unit and counit with those of finite adjunctions $F_n\dashv G_n$. On normalized inputs [def-coef-normalized-dvr-tower] assume the evaluation of the system internal Hom is identified with the finite internal Hom, preserving tensor evaluation.
Given a specified transformation $\alpha:F\to F'$ between such actual left adjoints with right adjoints $G,G'$, its ordinary mate $\alpha^R:G'\to G$ [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate] is an actual derived-system transformation; its finite evaluation is the ordinary mate of the evaluated transformation. For composable geometric functors with specified actual composition comparisons, these mate comparisons satisfy horizontal and vertical pasting as system equations, and are unchanged by counit-compatible uniqueness identifications of right adjoints.
Moreover system tensors computed on simultaneous flat-term K-flat resolutions [def-pc-kflat-complex, def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], their tensor-evaluation maps, and their closed tensor-Hom transposes are independent of representatives. Composing these maps with $\eta,\epsilon$ produces actual system morphisms; their evaluated maps and evaluated closed transposes are exactly the corresponding finite constructions. This applies whenever the inputs lie in the stated full subcategories and the tensors in question have normalized first input where the internal-Hom evaluation is used. Compatibility with quotient transitions and inverse identities is asserted in the ordinary derived-system category, before any total inverse limit. No lifting assertion is made for transformations given only at finite levels.

source.place: Final proof paragraph: units, counits and transposes before taking the derived limit, with ordinary composition mates; returned steps 16-17. Agent-formulated ordinary-system refinement; argument allocation and the complete retained argument are in the worker report.

proof.text: The statement quantifies over the already supplied SemilinearSections.Data on each actual site. Use its closed adjunctions, tensorModels.comparison, tensorEvaluation and homEvaluation_evaluation directly. No existence or choice of resolutions or closed structures is needed here. Naturality of tensorModels.comparison on the full subcategory of K-flat pairs is exactly the asserted representative-independence equation; the extra flat-term hypotheses need not be used.

For u the system transpose of h, apply the inverse finite closed Hom equivalence. Its counit formula is tensor(u,1) followed by evaluation. Factor tensor(e(u) followed by homEvaluation,1), substitute Data.homEvaluation_evaluation, and move tensor(e(u),1) past the inverse tensorEvaluation by naturality. Functoriality leaves inverse tensorEvaluation followed by e(uncurry(u)); the system Hom-equivalence inverse identity identifies uncurry(u) with h. Both inverse identities in the statement are the identities of these equivalences.

Apply the scalar adjunction Hom equivalence to the proposed reduction naturality equation. Its left and right naturality identities, and the definition of reduction as the inverse transpose of derivedTransition, reduce this to derivedTransition.naturality. For two-variable transpose naturality, apply the inverse closed equivalence, substitute evaluation_naturality in the Hom input, commute the tensor maps by bifunctoriality, and cancel the transpose/inverse-transpose pair. This proves actual system equations without detecting equality through finite evaluations.

Specialize SemilinearSections.evaluation_mate to identity horizontal functors and identity evaluation comparisons. Express alpha and its finite version as TwoSquares using left and right unitors. The supplied alpha compatibility is precisely the square hypothesis after unitors simplify. The conclusion simplifies, by the definition of conjugateEquiv, to the displayed finite mate evaluation equation. The two inverse mate equations are the two identities of conjugateEquiv.

The composition clause is conjugateEquiv_comp with the equality reversed. For right-adjoint uniqueness, expand rightAdjointUniq as the conjugate of the identity; conjugateEquiv_comp combines each side to the same mate, since composing alpha with an identity leaves alpha.

Instantiate mateEquiv_vcomp and mateEquiv_hcomp on the actual six full subcategories and their supplied adjunctions. These give the two pasting clauses verbatim, including the composite adjunctions. Combine the tensor, mate and pasting clauses for all the indicated schemes and site selectors.

proof_origin.place: Final ordinary-system refinement, categorical uncurrying and mate calculations from the already supplied Data; H2 proof of 2026-10-24. The original existence/construction steps are not needed for the universally quantified data statement.
